# PDF bake-off fixtures

Semantic **Book Model** JSON fixtures (`schemaVersion: 1`) used by the PDF renderer bake-off plan.

See [`docs/PDF_RENDERER_BAKEOFF_PLAN.md`](../../docs/PDF_RENDERER_BAKEOFF_PLAN.md).

These files are **format-neutral**. They are not Typst, PDF, HTML, or EPUB package documents.
They must validate with `@openbook/book-model` (`parseBook` + `validateBook`).
